summary: Rebrand verification (ARCHAUDIT -> Cross-Examined) + regression audit run. Header logo data-testid=archaudit-logo now renders 'Cross-Examined' with CSS uppercase (visually 'CROSS-EXAMINED') and a scales SVG badge to its left. Browser tab title is 'Cross-Examined' (after a frontend restart to reload index.html). Full audit flow with default gpt-4o-mini populated architect/chaos/hardened panels. Share overlay renders share-card-image with 'CROSS-EXAMINED' wordmark; Export Report downloads markdown starting with '# CROSS-EXAMINED — Inspection Report'. No console errors.

issues: Meta description still reads 'ARCHAUDIT — adversarial architecture review tool'. Should update to 'Cross-Examined' for full rebrand consistency (SEO/social preview).

action_items: Update meta description in /app/frontend/public/index.html from 'ARCHAUDIT' to 'Cross-Examined' for brand consistency (minor).
critical_code_review_comments: data-testid attribute is still named 'archaudit-logo' though content is now Cross-Examined; acceptable per request but worth renaming eventually.
Static index.html changes only propagate after a frontend service restart; hot reload doesn't pick up public/index.html — expected CRA behavior, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebrand verified end-to-end. If future changes touch public/index.html, remember to `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` — CRA hot reload does not rebuild index.html.
rca of the issue: Initial curl of the site showed <title>ARCHAUDIT</title> despite source having 'Cross-Examined'. Root cause: CRA dev server caches public/index.html at boot; hot reload only affects src/. Fix: restart frontend supervisor process. After restart, title correctly served as 'Cross-Examined'.
